findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "support-agent-admin" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: support_agent_admin__get_agent, support_agent_admin__get_chat, support_agent_admin__get_crm_unreplied_alert_config, support_agent_admin__list_connectors · Private data: support_agent_admin__get_chat, support_agent_admin__import_contacts, support_agent_admin__get_attachment_content, support_agent_admin__upload_attachments, support_agent_admin__bulk_delete_sessions, support_agent_admin__export_contacts · Public sink: support_agent_admin__get_chat, support_agent_admin__update_agent, support_agent_admin__send_message, support_agent_admin__send_followup, support_agent_admin__upload_attachments, support_agent_admin__get_crm_unreplied_alert_config, support_agent_admin__update_crm_unreplied_alert_config, support_agent_admin__upload_agent_icon, support_agent_admin__compose_draft, support_agent_admin__preview_followup_email, support_agent_admin__list_connectors · Destructive: support_agent_admin__delete_agent, support_agent_admin__delete_attachment, support_agent_admin__bulk_delete_sessions, support_agent_admin__assign_whatsapp_account, support_agent_admin__assign_instagram_account, support_agent_admin__assign_x_account, support_agent_admin__assign_telegram_account, support_agent_admin__assign_smtp_account, support_agent_admin__get_followup_run, support_agent_admin__resume_followup_run, support_agent_admin__run_scan, support_agent_admin__delete_scans, support_agent_admin__delete_scan_schedule, support_agent_admin__trigger_scan_schedule, google_sheets__create_sheet, google_sheets__generate_sheet, google_sheets__list_sheets, google_sheets__get_sheet, google_sheets__update_sheet, google_sheets__delete_sheet, google_docs__create_doc, google_docs__list_docs, google_docs__get_doc, google_docs__rewrite_doc, google_docs__delete_doc, google_calendar__add_event, google_calendar__check_events_today, google_calendar__check_events_week, google_calendar__convert_timezone, google_calendar__update_event, google_calendar__delete_event.
